exercises.instruction: Find ten pairs of synonyms (words that mean the same) in the box, then decide which word in each pair is British English and which word is American English. Put your answers in the table below.
Label each of the pictures with the correct British English word. Then, under each one, write the American English equivalent.
Replace the American English word in italics in these sentences with the equivalent word used in British English for the same context.
items: 1 We need to get rid of this garbage.
2 Are you going on vacation soon?
3 Put those things in the closet, will you?
4 It's quicker if you take the subway.
5 Be careful when you step off the sidewalk.
6 Could you get me a packet of chips?
7 I only wear an undershirt if it's really cold.
8 When is your daughter starting high school?
9 We're going to spend a few days there in the fall.
10 I think I'd better buy a round trip.
